definitions: An ultra-wide-angle lens that produces strong visual distortion intended to create a wide panoramic or hemispherical image.
A lens that captures an extremely wide-angle view, often distorting straight lines near the edges of the frame.
examples: He attached a fisheye lens to his camera.
The skateboarder used a fisheye lens for the trick shot.
The architect preferred a fisheye lens for interior shots.
